description: Mortgage prequalification email with NMLS ID, Equal Housing Lender, unsubscribe and postal address.
content:
Subject: See what you could prequalify for

Hi Jordan,

Thinking about buying or refinancing? You can find out where you stand in a few minutes. Get prequalified with ClearPath Home Lending and see your estimated options, with no obligation.

Prequalification uses a soft credit pull, so it will not affect your credit score. It is an estimate based on the information you provide, not a commitment to lend, and your terms may change once you submit a full application and we verify your details.

Start your prequalification: https://clearpath.example/home/start

Sincerely,
The ClearPath Home Lending Team
NMLS ID 2114468 | Equal Housing Lender

ClearPath Financial, 400 Market Street, Suite 900, San Francisco, CA 94111
You are receiving this email because you asked for mortgage updates. Unsubscribe: https://clearpath.example/unsubscribe
notes: Uses 'prequalified' (correct for a statement-based estimate), not 'pre-approved'. Contains every required mortgage and email element. No rates or payments are quoted, so no Reg Z triggering terms.
